note: Board and go (brief 018 §5), the twin of route-a-pressure: the same route to the ambush; then the Enforcer walks Vale to the car as it springs, the three fire until the blocker is down, then board, and the car leaves with the whole cell. Route A with Pressure for Help (Keel S25; Sky Q4): Pressure leans on her affair, learned by Listen ($0, +3 T, no step worse whatever her temperament: Motive, motive-lovers.md); the r016 cast's Inez is Fearful, so Pressure is also her own approach and one order turns her; the rest is route A. The cell runs where a player in a hurry would (to the café, the cabinet and the door): a run is noticed (Alert 1 at most), which the quiet route can afford. Brief 056 (Waymark, 2026-10-24; engine 0.28.0): with the drawn walk the Scout's cover by the car's east end (1175, -4825) is in rival-3's line as he walks to board once the blocker is down, and he is downed short of the car; the Scout now covers from the car's north-west corner (725, -4625, cv-003), the post route G fights it out from, and boards from there with the crew broken first.
